newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche says Dutch approve Roferon - A.
newsitem.headline: Roche says Dutch approve Roferon - A.

text.p: Roche Holding AG said its antiviral and anticancer drug Roferon-A would be available in all 15 European Union states after approval on February 26 from the Dutch Medicines Evaluation Board.
A Roche spokesman said a new EU procedure allowed one lead country to review a medication for approval which would then be automatic for all EU members.

"Patients within the European Union will ultimately have access to Roferon-A for the treatment of chronic Hepatitis B and C, chronic Myeloid leukaemia, renal cell carcinoma, non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, AIDS-related Kaposi's sarcoma and hairy cell leukemia," Roche said in a statement.
